title: Jesus... Two Years Of Praying The Same Prayer 🕯️
topic: he has prayed the same prayer for two years with no change and wonders if God is tired of hearing it

bible.text: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... Two years. The same prayer. Nothing has moved. 🕯️

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I stopped editing it months ago. Same words, same chair, same time, every single night.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I've heard it two thousand times, word for word, and I have never once been tired of it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why does it feel like silence? Two years is a long time to talk to a wall.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You have never been talking to a wall. Waiting is not a no. Some answers are grown, not granted.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: So keep asking. The waiting room is not the rejected pile, and I am not keeping score of the months.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone still praying the same prayer. 🕯️
